He had significant debts, including a court-ordered payment to his ex-wife and medical expenses for his premature son. Days before his death, he checked into different hotels and an Airbnb in Noida. Witnesses reported him expressing depression before the act. Police are currently investigating his financial situation and communications prior to the incident.

candidates.title: India-US trade talks hit ‘plateau’: Sitharaman
candidates.excerpt: India and the US have reached a challenging stage in their trade negotiations, according to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. She indicated that both nations must navigate a significant trade imbalance affecting their discussions. Trade talks continue, but reaching further concessions seems increasingly difficult as both sides evaluate their positions. Meanwhile, India is actively seeking bilateral agreements, especially with the European Union, to enhance market access.
